pratibhā,
tadutthaṃ
svapratibhottham, tad eva hi saṃsāratārakaṃ ghaṭate ; ato'rthāpattyā svapratbhottham eva
tārakaśabdārthaḥ / Pratibhotthatve hetum āha-- anaupadeśikam iti / Na hi sarvathā sarvaviṣayakaṃ
jñānaṃ śābdaṃ bhavituṃ yujyate, śabdasya sāmānyamātraviṣayakatvāt, paricchinnaviṣayakatvātc ceti
sarvaviṣayam ity atra sarvaśabdo'saṃkucita ity āha-- sarvaviṣayam iti / Sarvaviṣayakatvavacanād ity
arthaḥ / Atīteti / Atītādirūpaṃ sarvam ity anuvādo'nv[ay]ārthaḥ, paryāyaiḥ svagataviśeṣaiḥ sarvathā
niḥśeṣaiḥ viṣayīkarotīty arthaḥ, nāsti kramaḥ paurvāparyaṃ yatra jñānam ity akramam /
Akramāntaviśeṣaṇair labdhaṃ vākyatātparyārtham �
